subject: [hw] DONE V02 rev 4 (commit 8f1a431)
body:
Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v02/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V02 PASS 842/842
(ASan+UBSan -O1: 404/404, plain -O2: 404/404, TSan: 34/34.)

Since rev 3 (d7cd4f0):
- n2a32_mem_map/protect round the length to whole pages, so a partial-length remap zeroes its own page and leaves the next one alone (test included; this and the write-only-MMIO fix were in d7cd4f0).
- V20s D-form modified-immediate cases added: vmov.i32 d0,#0xff (f387001f), vmov.f32 d0,#1.0 (f2870f10), vorr.i32 d0,#0xff (f387011f) all route to neon_misc under V19s rule (the old (insn&0x60) test they saw is gone). Suite now 842.
- run_tests.sh prints N2TEST V02 FAIL <label> explicitly for a failing build or test binary instead of relying only on the ERR trap.

No core change since d7cd4f0. Still not compiled for arm64 iOS, not run on the phone, no performance numbers. Available for further findings.
